# The remedy tool runs in the test binary. It follows the exit codes of obee.
exec remedy --help
stdout '^  cut --old'
stdout '^  audit authored'

# An unknown command is a refusal: exit code 2.
! exec remedy bake
stderr 'unknown command "bake"'

# A report with no finding passes.
cd tree
exec remedy audit authored HEAD..HEAD
stdout 'AUD_AUTHORED_DONE'

# A cut with no origin remote is a refusal.
! exec remedy cut --old staging/r-I --new staging/r-II --pr 1
stderr 'cannot read the origin remote'
